main.summary: Describes the outcome of attempting to write a staged segmented transfer payload range.

property.name: Accepted
property.summary: True when the write request was accepted by storage.

property.name: CompletedCoverage
property.summary: True when the committed ranges cover the entire stream.

property.name: Updated
property.summary: The authoritative update time of the committed session state, when available.

property.name: Range
property.summary: The requested range associated with this write outcome.

property.name: Replayed
property.summary: True when the identical range had already been committed.

property.name: StateVersion
property.summary: The durable session state version after the write attempt.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Create a normalized segmented transfer write result.
method.param: The requested range associated with this write outcome.
True when the write request was accepted by storage.
